comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: There's two fleets that has the potential to drop the job card using the Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers. Their both Spanish NPC Fleets. One is called "Alonso Pinson" (the name is G.T. from the Japanese wiki, actual name may vary on Maris), he's usually seen arriving and departing from Santo Domingo. The other is "Vicente Pinson" (again the name might differ for us on Maris), who is seen around Cape San Roque Open Sea, usually arriving and departing from Pernambuco. If you lack Tactics skill or just dont have the rank to pull this job, this is something to look into.
